content.application_contract: For this application, select an independently declared existing human main_subject with an actual existing lower eyelid margin and lower lash strands already rooted along that same margin. Apply only the selected long lower-lash length to those same strands. Preserve the visible root-to-lower-lid connection, eyelid and eye shape, upper lashes, other face properties and established identity. Do not introduce lashes, add false lashes or mascara, create an eye, or replace the lower lid. The existing rooted-lash carrier is a prerequisite; the new long-length value is an effect and must not already be required as a prerequisite. Retain appearance/main_subject/face.eyelashes.lower_length exactly as the effect address; a manual role view may expose that same fact to lash_style but must not rename or relocate it. Both the original main_subject property lock and every selected lower-lash or lid receiver lock remain binding. If the existing carrier, same-owner/root connection, preservation values or necessary lock scope is unknown, keep this application pending.
